$comment: GOLDEN FACTS read from the source document, NOT from FinSight output.
A SCANNED filing: consolidated cash flow statement, INR crore, unseparated figures.
THE FILER'S OCR LAYER READS OPENING BRACKETS AS '1': '(2873.08)' is '12873.08',
'13584.22\'. A figure taken from that layer would be positive and ten times too
large. Every figure here was read from the render and every section re-added.
One cell prints a thousands comma ('9,026.00') in an otherwise unseparated column.
The adjustments' subtotal is unlabelled; working-capital lines are movements.

Phase 22: every row carries 'metric', the canonical key its printed label names, decided by reading the label in its statement (null: the taxonomy has no key for the line); 'metric_alt' lists keys that name the same measure. The scorer checks the key, not only the printed label.
